chunks: But whoever comes before Him a believer having done good deeds, will be raised to higher stations --
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for believers who perform good deeds according to Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual necessity of Iman (faith) and Amal al-Salih (righteous deeds) as the prerequisites for attaining Al-Darajat al-Ula, the highest spiritual stations. Scholars emphasize that these elevated ranks are not merely positional but reflect the depth of one's proximity to God, often associated with the Imams and the righteous who perfectly embody divine attributes.
